title: V6.2 Stage 2a: Thesis + Decision ONLY (grounded in Stage 1 output)
description: Stage 2a receives Stage 1's validated evidence_observations array and the calibrated numerical prior, and forms a thesis + decision. FIXED after real-model canary runs 35482706294/35485028854: this call no longer asks for entry/failure_exit at all -- that is a separate call (STAGE2_ACTIONABILITY_SCHEMA.json), made only when this call's decision is CANDIDATE/HIGH_CONVICTION, so the reported decision=CANDIDATE + entry.status=NOT_ACTIONABLE + null-price contradiction cannot be expressed by this schema at all.

evidence_quality.description: Scored only from Stage 1's per-family direction/timeliness/limitations for case_available families. Never scored by counting how many of the 10 registry families are present.

primary_evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of Stage 1's evidence_observations[*].evidence_id whose direction is SUPPORTIVE (or MIXED with a supportive component). NEUTRAL/NOT_INTERPRETABLE ids are never valid here.

secondary_evidence_ids.description: Subset of Stage 1 evidence_ids providing weaker/contextual support. Same SUPPORTIVE/MIXED-only restriction as primary_evidence_ids.

counter_evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of Stage 1's evidence_observations[*].evidence_id whose direction is CONTRADICTORY (or MIXED with a contradictory component). Every family whose Stage-1 direction is strictly CONTRADICTORY MUST appear here -- not optional. If bear_thesis references any evidence family's negative aspect, that family's id MUST also appear here.

system_limitations.description: Must exactly equal the system_unavailable_evidence_ids supplied for this case. Transparency-only.
